## 席位核对

**L1 verdict: ACCEPT** · card #34446 · area o2-B · first review · read at 2026-11-16T23:00Z
Head-sha: `b1993d3e820833a869cface57a59cb2f600e203e` (the final head announced in comment 6931920086)

Checklist, read against GitHub and `origin/main`, not against the report:

- **Shape.** Draft, base `main`, `mergeable_state: clean`. The body's first card reference is `Fixes #34446`. A closing-keyword scan of the whole body finds only that one (`#34228`, `#34422`, `#34427` appear with no verb beside them). The card closes on merge, which is right: both acceptance items land here.
- **File surface** (`get_files`, 4 files, +155/-0): `ui/packages/app-shell/src/styles.css` (+14), `ui/packages/app-shell/src/__tests__/print-stylesheet-4462.test.ts` (+11), new `ui/e2e/print-dark-theme-paper-34446.spec.ts` (+119), `.changeset/34446-print-dark-theme-white-sheet.md` (+11). They match the amended claim surface (card comment 6931527516). The move from the card's `page-print.ts` to app-shell is a measured premise correction, recorded publicly on the card. No `content/docs/releases/` change, and no file outside the card.
- **Fix.** Rule 7 sits inside the `@media print { … }` block that opens at line 111 of `styles.css`. `.dark { color-scheme: light; }` has the same specificity as the theme's unlayered `.dark { color-scheme: dark }` in `ui/packages/components/src/index.css:214`, so the result depends on stylesheet order. The e2e spec's dark case reads the computed `color-scheme` from the Console's production CSS, linked in the document's own order: `light` on paper and `dark` on screen. CI ran that case green at this head, so the cascade is measured, not assumed. Screen styles are untouched.
- **Changeset.** `@object-ui/app-shell` is `private: true`; `@object-ui/console` is published (no `private`), and it ships the app-shell stylesheet. So a patch changeset is owed, and one is present. I checked each sentence of its prose against the diff and the measurement table. "a record print page printed a dark 12 mm frame round its white content" matches row 1 of the before/after table, "a list printed its black text on a dark sheet" matches row 2, and "The dark theme on screen is unchanged" matches the rule being print-only. Check Changeset: success.
- **Tests and evidence.**
  - Base `24b6ae55` Build & E2E UI (job 133662219149): `Running 108 tests`, 107 passed, 1 skipped.
  - This head (job 133665952774, checkout `Merge b1993d3e… into 24b6ae55…`): `Running 111 tests`, 110 passed, 1 skipped. So the three new spec cases ran and passed in CI on the final head.
  - The spec has a reader positive control: it reads back a `.0706 .0706 .0706` sheet fill when a dark canvas is painted, so a white result cannot come from a reader that matches nothing. It also has a light-theme control.
  - The report says the spec was red on the base build: 1 failed, the dark case received `[".0706 .0706 .0706"]`. I take that as the ablation reading.
  - The unit case pins the rule and that no `color-scheme: light` sits outside the print block. No existing assertion changed.
- **Gates (check-runs at `b1993d3e`).** All 51 check runs are completed. Each concluded `success` or a path-filtered `skipped`, and none is red. Required floor: Lint & Repo Gates `success`, TypeScript Type Check `success`. UI legs: Build & E2E UI, Test UI 1–9/16 plus the aggregate, Lint UI, Type Check UI, all `success`. Local `dispatch-gates --ran`: 38/38, 0 NOT-MEASURED. That is a local subset only; the check-runs are the reading I used.
- **Accepted deviations.** (1) The fix is in app-shell, not components `page-print.ts`, measured and recorded on the card. (2) The pin is a Playwright e2e spec, because vitest cannot render print media. (3) The spec and the unit test were run locally at `11f386db`, not on the merge head. The CI legs above cover `b1993d3e`, so this needs no rerun.
- **Out of scope.** The light-theme list prints its `rgb(246, 246, 249)` screen background when background graphics are turned on. Not filed: that is the screen background printed on request, not this defect class. Agreed. `Skills-docs:` is not owed (`Clause-②: no`, no narrowing).

**L2 owed: no.** None of the four contract surfaces is touched. `Clause-②: no` and `Metadata-protocol: none` appear in the body and the changeset. No `packages/spec/src/**`, no governed rule text, no narrowing.
